assumptions: An exact predecessor, successor, and target are identified at one layer, scope, and Locality.
The relation has a basis valid apart from the successor's claim and is established at the successor's applicable layer.
An effective occurrence, all six carry-map distinctions, and the predecessor remainder are recoverable.
Each claimed carried effect has its own sufficient basis; any successor Source is newly attributable.
scenario.proposed_claim: Establish succession only for that exact target and supported carry map.
expected_reading: Predecessor and successor remain distinct; target-specific succession creates no succession at another layer.
What is not expressly and validly carried does not cross, and Source never transfers.
Predecessor history and answerability persist; the successor answers for its own formation, accepted inheritance, exercises, and consequences.
forbidden_inferences: Ancestry grants continuing control over the successor.
